info.description: One card in the homepage's 'Works with your systems' grid, linking to an integration manual.

tag.description: Short line above the title saying who it is for, e.g. 'No technical knowledge'. Optional.

url.description: Where the card links to, e.g. /integrations/google-sheets

icon.description: Heroicons name, rendered via BaseIcon.vue (collection='heroicons'). An enum, like audience-segment's, so an icon that doesn't exist can't be typed.
